notes.title: Version 0.4.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]Version 0.4.2[/h3]

Added a "Lock Input" button when selecting actions. When all people have clicked this button, the game will advance to the next round.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
The following bugs have been fixed:
- Fixed a bug that caused players not to see the AI names correctly.

For more information about how to report a bug, please check out here: [url=https://battleofthe4towers.wordpress.com/bug-reporting/]https://battleofthe4towers.wordpress.com/bug-reporting/[/url]

notes.title: Version 0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.4:[/h1]

[h2]Stat changes[/h2]
The stats menu has had a minor upgrade. It now shows you your wins (plus win percentage), losses and total plays.

[h2]Leader board improvements[/h2]
You can now view the top 10 global players on the leaderboards screen.

[h2]New Achievements[/h2]
Two new achievements have been added, see if you can unlock them.

For more information about how to report a bug, please check out here: https://battleofthe4towers.wordpress.com/bug-reporting/

notes.title: Version 0.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1][b]Version 0.3: AI takes over![/b][/h1]

[h2]AI Opponents[/h2]
Any slot that isn't filled with now be filled with AI opponents, an option to disable this will be added in the future.
This means you can now play the game by yourself as intended.

[h2]Additional Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Idle checker now only requires you to select an input. You can unselect it if you want and the game will count you as being active.
[*]The default player name is now blank meaning if the names fail to load you'll see nothing above the player head.
[*]When creating a lobby you can hover over an option to see what it does.
[*]If the host leaves they will be warned they are the host in the leave message.
[*]Player cards have been added to the main menu. You'll be able to see your steam name, icon and money. (If this fails to show you may not be connected to steam)
[/list]

[h2]The following bugs have been fixed (Hopefully):[/h2]
[list]
[*]Music in game now loops correctly.
[*]Pressing Esc in the options now saves your settings.
[/list]

For more information about how to report a bug, please check out here: [url=https://battleofthe4towers.wordpress.com/bug-reporting/]https://battleofthe4towers.wordpress.com/bug-reporting/[/url]

notes.title: 2x money event!
notes.content:
[h1][b]2x Money Event[/b][/h1]

For a limited time, all earnings will be doubled! That means if you win a match you get $1000, but if you lose you'll end up losing $200.
This event will last 1 week.

[h2][b] Money Glitch [/b][/h2]
Additionally, I am aware of a strange glitch that appears to be occurring with the player's current money. The glitch seems to put the player's gold down to zero for seemingly no reason. I am unable to find the cause, if you have any information please fill out a bug report below:
[url=https://forms.gle/Kytbch32LyZD2v9Q9]https://forms.gle/Kytbch32LyZD2v9Q9
[/url]

notes.title: Version 0.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.2 has launched bringing new features, improvements and changes.

[h2]Leaderboards[/h2]

Leaderboards have been added. You can see how you rank among your friends in two categories.

[h2]Improved Stats[/h2]

New Stats have been added to the stats menu, along with a little revamp.

[h2]Additional Warnings[/h2]
The following messages have been added to the game:
[list]
[*] Trying to leave the game will now give you a warning before you leave or not.
[*] When the host leaves a game the players will be given a message to show what happened and kicked back to the main menu.
[/list]
[h2]UI changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Made a few changes to the main menu to fit better on smaller resolutions
[*] Lobby type drop-down scales better.
[*] When connecting to a lobby, you will now see a "connecting..." message. This message will only go away after successfully joining or failing to connect.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
The following bugs have been fixed (Hopefully)
[list]
[*] The mouse Sensitivity slider now saves correctly.
[*] Player movement is now consistent based on settings.
[*] Sound and Music sliders now update correctly.
[*] Leaving the game should now allow you to create a new game.
[*] Kicking a player now correctly brings them back to the main menu
[/list]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] You can no longer join a game that is in progress
[*] Fixed spelling errors :p
[/list]

For more information about how to report a bug, please check out here: https://battleofthe4towers.wordpress.com/bug-reporting/

notes.title: Version 0.1.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.1.5 has launched. 
The following bugs have been fixed:
[list]
[*] Failing to connect to a lobby should no longer take you to an empty lobby.
[*] Due to an error with the last version, you can once again start the game with only 1 player in the lobby.
[/list]

[i]Hopefully this fixes the major connection issues[/i]

If any of these issues are still around, please submit a bug report.
For more information about how to report a bug, please check out here:
[url=https://battleofthe4towers.wordpress.com/bug-reporting/]https://battleofthe4towers.wordpress.com/bug-reporting/[/url]

notes.title: Aware of connection issues
notes.content:
It was recently discovered there were issues involving connecting and starting a game. 
These issues stop players from playing the game and completely destroy the game.
I am currently working on a fix and hope to have I simple fix by Tuesday (March 22nd) with improvements and overall fixes coming soon after.
The fix will launch in version 0.1.5.
Thanks for understanding.
